verification.spec: Register a forward hook on a linear layer of a small model, pass calibration data through it, and invoke the GPTQ Hessian accumulation routine. verification.spec: Construct a synthetic PSD Hessian H, call the damping routine with percdamp=0.01, and verify the routine adds (0.01 * mean(diag(H))) to each diagonal element of H before Cholesky/inversion. Assert diag(H_damped) - diag(H) == 0.01 * mean(diag(H)) uniformly.

verification.spec: Run GPTQ on a small linear layer (e.g., 128x128) with a known weight matrix and Hessian. Verify: (1) columns are quantized in order (or blocked order), (2) after quantizing column i, the residual error is propagated to columns j>i via -err * H_inv[i, j:]/H_inv[i,i], and (3) the final quantized layer has strictly lower output MSE than naive RTN on the same calibration data.
